record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Does the d-reflection functor preserve arbitrary products of T0 spaces; equivalently, for every family {X_i}, is the Topd-reflection (prod_i X_i)^d homeomorphic to prod_i X_i^d, where Topd is the category of d-spaces?

evidence.quote: Question 7.16. ([49]) Does the d-reflection functor preserves arbitrary products of T0 spaces?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbf{Top}_0$ denote the category of $T_0$ topological spaces with continuous maps. A $T_0$ space $X$ is called a $d$-space (or monotone convergence space) if its specialization order makes $X$ a dcpo and every directed subset $D \subseteq X$ converges (with respect to the specialization order) to its supremum, equivalently if every directed subset of $X$ has a supremum in the specialization order and the closure of $D$ equals $\downarrow \sup D$. Let $\mathbf{Top}_d$ denote the full subcategory of $\mathbf{Top}_0$ consisting of $d$-spaces. The inclusion $\mathbf{Top}_d \hookrightarrow \mathbf{Top}_0$ has a left adjoint, the $d$-reflection functor, which assigns to each $T_0$ space $X$ a $d$-space $X^d$ together with a continuous map $\eta_X : X \to X^d$ universal among continuous maps from $X$ into $d$-spaces.

Question: Does the $d$-reflection functor preserve arbitrary products of $T_0$ spaces? Equivalently, for every family $\{X_i\}_{i \in I}$ of $T_0$ spaces, is the canonical continuous map
$$\Big(\prod_{i \in I} X_i\Big)^d \longrightarrow \prod_{i \in I} X_i^d$$
a homeomorphism?
artifact.category_tag: d-spaces and reflections in non-Hausdorff topology
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed among open problems in recent surveys on well-filtered and sober spaces in non-Hausdorff topology. Related work on the sobrification and d-reflection (e.g., Xu-Shen-Xi-Zhao and Xi-Lawson) addresses preservation of properties by products, and the analogous question for the sobrification is also reported open. No published resolution of the product-preservation question for the d-reflection functor was found.

status_evidence.title: On T0 spaces determined by well-filtered spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies d-reflection, well-filtered reflection and sobrification of T0 spaces; raises questions about preservation of products by such reflections.
status_evidence.claim: The d-reflection of T0 spaces is studied; product preservation is a known related open question.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems including whether reflection functors preserve products of T0 spaces.
status_evidence.claim: The problem appears as an explicitly listed open question in the survey on well-filtered and sober spaces.
